title: Making a game that turns your photos into collectible creatures
author: Few-North-6032
selftext:
I've been vibe coding a game, Shutterlings, that uses AI to turn your photos into collectible creatures complete with stats and funny ability names. Once your Shutterling is created, it becomes part of the game's ecosystem and other players can encounter, battle, and catch it for their own collection. The game keeps track of each Shutterling's population and its total win/loss record.

It has different play modes like Photo Walk where players progress through the Shutterling world, fighting stronger Shutterlings, encountering bosses, and completing photo quests. There are also Gym Battles and asynchronous PvP battles called. Full ranked PvP has been added to the game, but remains disabled until when and if there enough players to support it.

The game is currently in early access on Android [Shutterlings](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shutterlings.game). My next steps are to make the game available on iOS and improve the UI and visuals of the game. What are your thoughts, and where can I improve the game further?
